blocks.text: Twenty focus areas become eighteen initiatives, one per focus area except where one owner delivers two.

The plan follows one chain from vision to measure. Each level answers a different question. The pillar says what must change and the focus area says where; the initiative says what Wesgro and its partners do, and the indicator says how Steerco will know it has happened (section 5.1).

Seven levels run from the vision to the measures, and each has a fixed count in this plan. One vision says where the province is going: grow international arrivals from 1.5m in 2025 toward 2.5m by 2035. Three pillars say what must change, such as Reshape demand. Six themes say in which part of the system, such as source market growth and diversification. Twenty focus areas say where the evidence says to act, such as Convert India and China hub traffic. Eighteen initiatives say what Wesgro and its partners do, such as I4 India and China hub conversion. The 117 actions say who does what, by tier, such as activation inside Xiaohongshu, Douyin and MakeMyTrip. The indicators, 7 at impact, 28 at outcome and 37 at output level, say how Steerco knows, such as T2-06 India and China hub arrivals. The counts come from Chapter 3, the action tables and the traceability table in Appendix A1.

Two merges take twenty focus areas to eighteen initiatives. Segment-led marketing and mature-market yield share one owner and one set of channels, so focus areas 1 and 5 form initiative I1. Institutional alignment and industry collaboration share one forum, so focus areas 16 and 17 form I15. Every other focus area has its own initiative, numbered I1 to I18 in one sequence so that the M&E toolkit can track them on one list.

Leads are proposed, not agreed. They follow the Wesgro units named in the Inception Report's stakeholder map and the actions in Chapter 3, and Steerco confirms them at its first meeting [Steerco to confirm initiative leads and partners]. Six initiatives have a partner as the accountable lead, because the main lever sits outside Wesgro's mandate: corridor mobility, quality standards, flagship sites, community pilots, LTO funding and skills.

blocks.message: Eighteen initiatives cover the twenty focus areas, and eleven of them are in implementation by 2028. Thirteen draw mainly on Wesgro's operating budget, and four need private capital as a main source.
